subject: Follow-up: temporary compensating controls, remediation timeline & bridge letter request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Stokes <elaine.stokes@greentree.com>, BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: temporary compensating controls, remediation timeline & bridge letter request

Elaine / BrightPath team —

Thanks for the audit window walkthrough yesterday. Per the finding flagged under change management (control ref CM-07), our engineering team has implemented a temporary compensating control while we complete the planned code rollout that fully closes the gap. I attached our formal management response and a bundle of evidence. High level: 

- Root cause: an edge case in the deployment orchestration allowed an out-of-band config change to persist without the new approval hook.
- Interim compensating control: automated policy-based alerts + a short-lived CIDR lock and enhanced config drift monitoring (active since 2027-05-28).
- Planned remediation: deploy configuration gating and automated approval checks in the runtime service (targeted completion: 2027-09-30).

Requesting two clarifications to close the loop for GreenTree's procurement & vendor-risk team: 
1) Would BrightPath be able to issue a bridge letter or interim attestation that documents acceptance of the compensating control and covers the audit period through 2027-09-30?
2) If so, can you confirm what language you need from our side (we included a suggested paragraph in bridge_letter_draft.docx) and whether you require DocuSign or a separate auditor-signed PDF?

Attached: management_response_v1.pdf, compensating-controls-evidence.zip, bridge_letter_draft.docx.

Proposed next steps: Jordan (me) will coordinate with procurement and GreenTree; Naomi will send the technical evidence package and a proposed bridge-letter paragraph; Grace can provide a short executive note if procurement asks for it.

Can you confirm receipt and let us know any required edits to the draft bridge letter?

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for LLMs

From: Elaine Stokes <elaine.stokes@greentree.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>, procurement@greentree.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: temporary compensating controls, remediation timeline & bridge letter request

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick update and the packet. A couple of clarifying items from vendor risk: 

- We will need an auditor-issued bridge letter that explicitly states BrightPath's acceptance of the compensating control and the audit-period coverage dates.
- Please include the exact control ref(s) and the timeline for when the compensating control was activated.
- Procurement may ask for an executive attest (one paragraph) that the issue will be remediated by the date you list. A signed DocuSign is preferred for our contract file.

I reviewed the bridge_letter_draft.docx and it looks close — would appreciate BrightPath's input on wording as well. Can Jordan or Naomi coordinate a brief 20-minute call today/this week with our vendor-risk and procurement folks to confirm wording and next steps?

Regards,

Elaine Stokes
Head of Vendor Risk, GreenTree Bank
elaine.stokes@greentree.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Stokes <elaine.stokes@greentree.com>, BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: temporary compensating controls, remediation timeline & bridge letter request

Elaine / BrightPath —

Appreciate the note. Quick technical addendum and a suggested bridge-letter paragraph below. I included the evidence bundle (compensating-controls-evidence.zip) with logs, alert configs, and a short runbook for the temporary process.

Technical summary (concise):
- Compensating control active: real-time config-drift detection rules + policy enforcement that auto-rolls back unauthorized changes to a quarantined namespace and triggers a PagerDuty alert.
- Activated: 2027-05-28 03:14:21 UTC.
- Monitoring/retention: audit logs retained and exported to the secure evidence bucket for 180 days; alert playbook validated by SOC on 2027-05-29.
- Permanent fix: CI gating + automated approval checks targeted for release to prod by 2027-09-30 (engineering ticket: INF-4821).

Suggested paragraph for bridge letter (feel free to edit):
"Redwood Inference has implemented a compensating control consisting of automated configuration drift detection and real-time rollback with notification to our SOC team. The control was activated on 2027-05-28 and will remain in place until the permanent remediation (CI gating and automated approval checks) is deployed, targeted by 2027-09-30. BrightPath Audit Services has reviewed the evidence package and acknowledges this compensating control pending completion of the remediation plan."

If BrightPath can sign the bridge letter with similar language, that will satisfy GreenTree's procurement. For the DocuSign step: Jordan — please route the final bridge-letter PDF to procurement@greentree.com and include Grace's executive note if they request it. Rishi — I copied you to flag any billing/credit implications that sales should be aware of for the customer.

Attachments included in the internal/external thread: compensating-controls-evidence.zip (logs/playbook), bridge_letter_draft.docx (editable language), management_response_v1.pdf (formal management response).

Thanks —

Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Elaine Stokes <elaine.stokes@greentree.com>
Cc: procurement@greentree.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: temporary compensating controls, remediation timeline & bridge letter request

Jordan / Naomi / Elaine —

Thanks for the submission and the evidence bundle. BrightPath has reviewed the materials and is prepared to issue an interim bridge letter that acknowledges the compensating control and documents coverage through 2027-09-30, contingent on the evidence provided. Our auditor note will reference control CM-07 and the activation timestamp you provided.

Next steps from BrightPath: 
- We will prepare a signed PDF and place it in DocuSign for Redwood to route to GreenTree procurement (link below).
- The signed bridge letter will be archived with the audit working papers and referenced in our final report as an accepted exception with remediation planned.

Signed bridge letter (DocuSign envelope): https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d4e
Download (auditor copy): https://secure.brightpath.com/records/BRP-2027-06-03-bridge-jb.pdf

If anything changes with the remediation timeline, please notify BrightPath promptly. Otherwise, we'll mark the exception as accepted pending closure by the target date.

Regards,

BrightPath Audit Team
audits@brightpath.com
